summary: End-to-end testing of new PDF export + RSVP guest list features for White Vision portal. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_rsvp.py (14/14 pytest cases pass) covering invitation save with rsvp_enabled/rsvp_deadline, public GET invitation, POST /public/invitations/{token}/rsvp for yes/no/maybe (no sets guests=0), bad token 404, invalid attending 400, rsvp_enabled=false returns 400, GET /events/{id}/rsvps for owning customer / admin / assigned DJ (all 200) and other customer 404, DELETE /rsvps/{id}, and event stats rsvp aggregation (responses/attending_guests/declined/maybe). Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): customer jeroen@example.nl → Uitnodiging shows both PNG and PDF buttons; PDF download triggered with suggested filename 'uitnodiging-jeroen-mark.pdf' (.pdf). Tekst tab shows inv-rsvp-switch and inv-rsvp_deadline-input; save persists; share returns token; /u/<token> (unauthenticated) renders invitation + rsvp-form; empty submit shows rsvp-error 'Laat even weten of je komt.'; selecting yes + name + guests + message submits and reveals rsvp-success. Customer /event/<id>/gasten shows stats (3 Gasten komen, 1 Reactie, 0/0 misschien/komen niet), filter buttons, rsvp-search-input, rsvp-export-button, and the guest row. Dashboard card-guests updated to '3 gasten komen · 1 reacties · 0 misschien · 0 komen niet'. Admin event detail → admin-tab-guests renders the same guest-list including TEST_UI_Guest.

issues: html-to-image emits a benign console SecurityError when inlining Google Fonts stylesheet (cross-origin). Final PDF still generated successfully, but console shows errors that could confuse debugging. Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/rsvp.py: no rate limiting on POST /public/invitations/{token}/rsvp — an attacker with a leaked share token can spam up to MAX_PER_EVENT (1000) rows. Consider per-IP/token rate-limit or captcha before launch.
routes/rsvp.py submit_rsvp passes body.model_dump() plus event_id into Rsvp(...) — works because Rsvp model has only those fields, but if InvitationFields/Rsvp drift this will raise. Minor.
InvitationBuilder.jsx downloadPdf uses toPng@pixelRatio 3 then embeds into jsPDF — large images (~2.5 MB per PDF) will be slow on mobile. Consider jpeg format or lower pixelRatio for mobile.
GuestList.jsx exportCsv does not include timestamp (created_at); minor but useful for couples to track order of replies.

PublicInvitation.jsx RsvpForm: guests input not reset to 1 when switching from yes→no→yes (because of `form.attending !== 'no'` hiding the field). Not a functional issue but UX could show 1 by default.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 new RSVP tests; prior 32/32 still passing)

seed_data_creation: Cleanup: dropped all docs in db.invitations and db.rsvps (test_database) after testing so the demo starts with invitation unsaved as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RSVP regression lives in /app/backend/tests/test_rsvp.py. Run with 'pytest -p no:xdist' (default pytest.ini enables xdist which splits classes across workers and breaks shared-fixture ordering for TestPublicRsvp→TestRsvpList). All data-testids used in review request are present and functional. Cross-origin console error from html-to-image (Google Fonts CSS rules) is informational only — PDF/PNG still render. No functional bugs observed.
rca of the issue: N/A — all features work as specified.
